result.topic_en: Euler gives an inductive method for resolving N into four squares and into five pentagonal numbers, assuming every smaller number can be so resolved, and states a general problem for π-gonal numbers.
result.transcription:
Fragmenta ex Adversariis depromta. 193

Problema. Si omnes numeri minores quam $N$ fuerint summae quatuor quadratorum, ipsum numerum $N$ in quatuor quadrata resolvere.

Solutio. Sint pro numero quocunque minore $N-p$ quadratorum radices $a, b, f, g$, unde pro numero $N$ statuantur radices $x, y$ et $f, g$, ac ponatur $x=a+\alpha$ et $y=b+\beta$, eritque ab hoc $N-p$ subtracto
$p=2a\alpha+\alpha\alpha+2b\beta+\beta\beta.$
Jam sumatur $\alpha=-n$ et $\beta=+n$, ut fiat $p=2n(b-a)+2nn$; quare si fuerit $b=a+d$, habebitur $p=2(nd+nn)$, qui numerus duplo major est quam casu praecedente, pro numeris trigonalibus; unde eadem criteria locum habebunt, quae ante, si modo numerus $p$ duplo major capiatur. Ita resolutio numeri $N-p$ succedet
si pro numero $N-2$ fuerit $b=a$ tum erit $x=a-1$, $y=b+1$
$N-4$ $b=a+1$ $x=a-1$, $y=b+1$
$N-6$ $b=a+2$ $x=a-1$, $y=b+1$
$N-8$ $b=a+3$ $x=a-1$, $y=b+1$
$b=a$ $x=a-2$, $y=b+2$
$N-10$ $b=a+4$ etc. etc.
etc. etc.
Hic ergo patet, pro hoc casu numerum criteriorum esse duplo majorem quam casu praecedente: Verum quia hic quatuor occurrunt radices, etiam hic multo probabilius est, inter quaternas radices occurrere duas, quarum differentia sit vel 0, vel 1, vel 2, vel 3, vel etc. Quin etiam plerique numeri pluribus modis in quatuor quadrata resolvi poterunt, unde hoc judicium aeque certum esse potest ac praecedens.

Problema. Si omnes numeri minores quam $N$ fuerint resolubiles in quinque numeros pentagonales, ipsum numerum $N$ in tales partes resolvere.

Solutio. Sint pro numero $N-p$ radices quinque pentagonalium $a, b, f, g, h$, unde pro ipso numero $N$ statuantur quinque radices $x, y, f, g, h$, ac ponatur $x=a+\alpha$ et $y=b+\beta$, eritque
$\frac{3xx-x}{2}-\left(\frac{3aa-a}{2}\right)=\frac{6a\alpha+3\alpha\alpha-\alpha}{2}$ et $\frac{3yy-y}{2}-\left(\frac{3bb-a}{2}\right)=\frac{6b\beta+3\beta\beta-\beta}{2}$,
unde fiet $p=3a\alpha+\frac{3\alpha\alpha-\alpha}{2}+3b\beta+\frac{3\beta\beta-\beta}{2}.$
Sumatur nunc $\alpha=-n$ et $\beta=+n$ eritque $p=3n(b-a)+3nn$; quare si fuerit $b=a+d$, fiet $p=3(nd+nn)$, ita ut hoc casu $p$ sit triplo majus quam pro trigonalibus, unde eadem criteria locum habebunt, si modo ipso $p$ valor triplo major tribuatur; hinc igitur resolutio semper succedet
si pro numero $N-3$ fuerit $b=a$
$N-6$ $b=a+1$
$N-9$ $b=a+2$
$N-12$ $\begin{cases} b=a+3 \\ b=a \end{cases}$
ex quibus criteriis, si unicum tantum locum habuerit, resolutio numeri $N$ certe succedit. Hic quidem triplo pauciora habentur criteria. Verum inter quinque radices reperientur binae, quarum differentia sit vel 0, vel 1, vel 2, vel 3, etc. Praeterea vero etiam plerique numeri multo pluribus modis in quinque pentagonales resolvi possunt.

Problema generale circa numeros polygonales quoscunque, quorum laterum numerus sit $=\pi$.
Si omnes numeri minores quam N resolvi queant in $\pi$ numeros polygonales, etiam ipsum numerum N in tales resolvere.

L. Euleri Op. posthuma. T. I. 25

methods.what: Inductive step for four squares: change two roots by -n and +n, giving the increment p
With alpha=-n, beta=+n and b=a+d, increment is p=2(nd+nn), twice the triangular case
Criteria table: N resolvable if N-2k has two roots differing by a suitable amount
methods.quote: si pro numero $N-2$ fuerit $b=a$ tum erit $x=a-1$, $y=b+1$

methods.what: Difference of pentagonal numbers for shifted roots
With alpha=-n, beta=n, b=a+d, pentagonal increment p=3(nd+nn), three times the triangular case
Criteria for five pentagonals from N-3, N-6, N-9, N-12

items.quote: Si omnes numeri minores quam $N$ fuerint summae quatuor quadratorum, ipsum numerum $N$ in quatuor quadrata resolvere.
items.english: If all numbers less than N are sums of four squares, to resolve the number N itself into four squares.

items.quote: etiam hic multo probabilius est, inter quaternas radices occurrere duas, quarum differentia sit vel 0, vel 1, vel 2, vel 3, vel etc.
items.english: here too it is much more probable that among the four roots there occur two whose difference is 0, or 1, or 2, or 3, etc.

items.quote: unde hoc judicium aeque certum esse potest ac praecedens.
items.english: hence this judgement can be just as certain as the preceding one.

items.quote: Si omnes numeri minores quam $N$ fuerint resolubiles in quinque numeros pentagonales, ipsum numerum $N$ in tales partes resolvere.
items.english: If all numbers less than N are resolvable into five pentagonal numbers, to resolve N itself into such parts.

items.quote: ex quibus criteriis, si unicum tantum locum habuerit, resolutio numeri $N$ certe succedit.
items.english: if even one of these criteria holds, the resolution of the number N certainly succeeds.

items.quote: Verum inter quinque radices reperientur binae, quarum differentia sit vel 0, vel 1, vel 2, vel 3, etc.
items.english: But among five roots there will be found two whose difference is 0, or 1, or 2, or 3, etc.

items.quote: Si omnes numeri minores quam N resolvi queant in $\pi$ numeros polygonales, etiam ipsum numerum N in tales resolvere.
items.english: If all numbers less than N can be resolved into π polygonal numbers, to resolve the number N itself into such numbers too.
